capabilities.label: Firecrawl-First Web Routing
capabilities.summary: Route public reading and extraction to local Firecrawl; reserve the isolated per-client browser harness for interactive UI work.
capabilities.outputs: Selected web lane, readiness requirement, and bounded fallback rule.
capabilities.cost_per_call: local Firecrawl or existing browser runtime
capabilities.rate_limit: Two failed attempts per selected lane before diagnostic stop

routing_policy.public_read: Use web_extract backed by FIRECRAWL_API_URL; local Firecrawl is the default.
routing_policy.interactive: Use the existing per-client browser harness for clicks, typing, authentication, uploads, downloads, and UI screenshots.
routing_policy.specialized: Prefer an existing tested domain harness for a known brittle workflow; do not create a generic Playwright wrapper.
routing_policy.isolation: Browser profiles, cookies, tabs, and CDP endpoints are per-client and must never be shared.
routing_policy.failure_budget: After two failed attempts on the selected lane, stop and return a diagnostic; do not spawn another browser, profile, or daemon.
routing_policy.closeout: Reuse tabs where possible and close task-created tabs when the task ends.
